Add picture

For best results: shoot the picture straight on, in good light, with no glare. Pictures with lots of detail work best. Plain logos, blank walls and very shiny surfaces track poorly.
Drag the corners so the box holds only the picture.

Understanding your picture

The app finds the sky, water, trees, people and lights in your picture, and how deep everything is, then moves each part in its own way.

Pick a video from your phone. It plays on top of the picture whenever the camera finds it.

Making your 3D model

How it is made: the front is shaped from the real depth in your photo. The back and sides cannot be seen in one photo, so the app rounds them off and mirrors the front. For a full 360 degree model with a true back, a scan from all sides is needed.
